ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD and Enhanced Due Diligence under the Samoa AML/CFT Act 2007; all proposed directors, shareholders, authorized signatories and ultimate beneficial owners are screened prior to incorporation against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the US OFAC SDN List, the consolidated EU/UK sanctions lists, and the domestic sanctions/designated persons list administered by the Central Bank of Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; politically exposed persons (domestic and foreign) and their immediate family members and close associates require senior management approval of the registered agent, enhanced monitoring and documented source of wealth verification; screening results are archived by the registered agent for a minimum of five (5) years in accordance with FIU directives.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) of Samoa - International Companies filings and name reservations are submitted exclusively through a licensed Samoan Registered Agent; no direct public self-service portal exists for International Company name reservations.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name must be expressed in Latin/Roman characters; a parallel name in the Samoan (Gagana Samoa) language is permitted; the standard statutory suffix must appear in approved English or Latin-derived form ('Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Societe Anonyme', 'Limited Liability Company' or approved abbreviation); a Chinese-language commercial name is permitted only as an internal/trading designation and may be noted in the corporate records, but Chinese script characters are not accepted as the statutorily registered company name in the Samoan registry; any non-English name must be transliterated into Latin script for the certificate of incorporation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Samoa (requires prior consent of the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant through its licensed registered agent files a written Request for Reconsideration with the Registrar of International Companies within fourteen (14) days of the notice of refusal; the Registrar must issue a determination within ten (10) business days of receipt; if the refusal is maintained, a formal administrative appeal may be lodged with the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within twenty-one (21) days of the adverse determination, supported by a legal submission demonstrating compliance with the International Companies Act 1987 naming provisions; the Minister's decision is subject to judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa. A rejected name is not refundable, and re-submission under a reformed name is available immediately.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is NOT permissible for the statutory registered office of a Samoa International Company; the company must at all times maintain a physical registered office in Samoa situated at the premises of its licensed Registered Agent. Remote or virtual administrative support may be used exclusively for the non-Samoan commercial operations (e.g., Kickstarter campaign management, PayPal and Stripe settlement, product fulfillment) provided that no physical operational footprint is established in Samoa.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. For a Low_Risk_Standard, non-licensed artisan gaming accessory manufacturer, the quantified probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection at the registered agent's Samoan premises is approximately 3% per annum; this risk rises to approximately 10-15% only where the Financial Intelligence Unit flags anomalous PEP exposure, sanctions screening hits, or inconsistent source-of-wealth documentation. The company itself, being a foreign-operating pass-through entity with no physical premises in Samoa, is not subject to direct on-site inspection under standard administration.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss. 3-7 (formation and incorporation); International Companies Regulations 1988; Companies Act 2001 (limited application to incidental local matters)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Registrar of International Companies (IC-1/IC-2/IC-3 filing package)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued or paid-up capital for international companies under the ICA 1987; capital may be denominated in any currency; no escrow or capital duty account required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: IN THE MATTER OF [Company] International Company Limited — FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION. RESOLVED: (1) The subscriber share allotments recorded in the Share Register are ratified and issued to the founding shareholders per the Memorandum and Articles of Association. (2) The registered office located at Apia, Samoa and the appointment of [Registered Agent], a licensed Samoa international company agent, are adopted. (3) [Director 1], [Director 2] and [Director 3] are appointed as first directors, and [Secretary] as Company Secretary. (4) The directors are authorized to open bank and digital payment processor accounts (Stripe, PayPal) and to undertake all filings required by the International Companies Act 1987. Effective immediately upon adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation application for a name ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.', together with the registered agent's written consent. The name may include a Chinese/English dual-language clause. No notarization is required at this pre-filing stage.
required_dossiers: Identity of subscriber(s) and jurisdiction of risk profile
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or undesirability, file an amended name reservation within 14 days or request written reasons and appeal to the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Submission of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English and submit the complete IC-1/IC-2/IC-3 package through the MCIL registry window or accredited agent. The registered agent attests the subscriber signatures.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a correction query, cure the noted deficiency and re-file within 21 days; late re-filing attracts a nominal penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Statutory Fees and Issuance of Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Cash Office / Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the US$100 incorporation fee at the MCIL cash office or via approved bank transfer. Upon payment confirmation, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the company comes into existence.
required_dossiers: Drafted Certificate of Incorporation cover sheet
Power of attorney if filed through agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the payment is insufficient or untraceable, the Registrar notes the deficiency; re-tender the same within 7 days to prevent rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) / licensed international company agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain a registered office in Samoa at the licensed agent's place of business. File the registered office and agent appointment form; the agent must hold a valid SIFA license for the term of appointment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent is deregistered or objects, the company must appoint a replacement licensed agent within 28 days and notify the Registrar promptly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolutions and Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass unanimous written resolutions to ratify subscriber allotments, adopt the registered office, appoint officers, open bank/processor accounts, and approve authorized signatories. Record minutes in the statutory minute book.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or written consent
Register of members and share ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a document is rejected on audit, rectify the minutes with a confirmatory board resolution and file amended registers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour — Industrial Licensing Unit (not applicable as this artisanal dice-casting business is exempt from the industrial licensing threshold)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required (no operational or manufacturing permit applies to non-hazardous craft resin casting; the activity is below mandatory licensing thresholds under Samoan law)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt registration — no Full EIA Report required for a micro-scale craft studio without industrial effluent discharge, under the Environment Act 2003 and Environment (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2007
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater discharge to waterways; fugitive VOC concentrations from epoxy resin handling and curing shall not exceed applicable indoor occupational thresholds; cured resin waste and sharp-edge trimmings must be solidified and disposed of at a licensed waste facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority, structural load confirmation for the craft studio, and occupational health clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2006 for handling epoxy resins and sharps.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Matagaluega o Tupe Maua), Apia, Samoa; online service portal at https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is statutorily exempt from all Samoan national taxes and duties; no TIN is required for tax purposes. The IC obtains an annual Tax Exemption Certificate from the Ministry for Revenue (supported by the certificate of incorporation from the Registrar of International Companies under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour). If a TIN is nevertheless required for banking, customs, or counterparty due-diligence purposes, a non-resident entity files an Application for Registration for Income Tax / VAGST with the Ministry for Revenue, attaching certified copies of the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, director passport pages, and a local agent appointment form. The exemption certificate is issued within 5 working days; TIN issuance for non-residents takes 3-10 working days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Samoan law. An IC may voluntarily apply to the Registrar to convert to a domestic company under the Companies Act 2006, thereby prospectively losing the IC tax exemption; no hybrid mismatch or fiscal-transparent election is available. An IC cannot elect to be taxed on a resident basis. Special Economic Zone incentives are not applicable to ICs under the current regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) under the VAGST Act 2008, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory registration where annual taxable turnover exceeds WST 50,000 (approximately USD 19,000); voluntary registration permitted below threshold. ICs carrying on offshore business only are outside the charge to VAGST.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate, no government digital stamping, and no mandatory e-invoicing API regime in Samoa. Registered taxpayers must issue a tax invoice in the statutory form for every taxable supply and file VAGST returns electronically via the Ministry for Revenue online portal; electronic records are admissible, but a physical printed tax invoice remains the contemporaneous evidence required for input credit and export claims.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply and to certain services supplied to non-residents (services performed wholly outside Samoa or directly in connection with exported goods). The supplier must retain proof of export, and the recipient must be outside Samoa; the claim must be made in the VAGST return with the statutory declaration and documentary annexures attached.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Cancelled Customs Export Declaration (CusDec) bearing sacnned Samoa Customs stamp
Original Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Samoan port
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the CusDec
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue audits export zero-rating claims against customs manifests and CBS banking records. Under the Tax Administration Act 2012 and VAGST Act 2008, fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating attracts penalty tax up to 150% of the shortfall, civil penalties of WST 10,000, imprisonment of directors up to 5 years, and retrospective clawback of the wrongly zero-rated VAT with interest accruing from the original filing date; input credits claimed on related acquisitions are also disallowed for up to 5 prior tax periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) – Exchange Control Division
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tālā (WST) is not fully convertible under classical exchange control. Current-account transactions (trade, services, royalties, and routine operating payments) are generally authorised by licensed commercial banks under delegated authority from the CBS. Capital-account transactions including equity injections, dividend distributions, and intercompany loans require either prior CBS approval or conformity with an automatic exemption. A Samoa International Company (IC) is treated as a non-resident entity for exchange control purposes; it may freely maintain and operate foreign-currency accounts in USD, EUR, AUD, and WST and may remit profits to non-resident shareholders without individual CBS pre-approval, provided that funds are sourced from offshore business operations and not from domestic Samoan sales. Practical remittance approvals are standard within 2–5 business days when the sampled documentation is complete.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations, resident exporters must surrender export proceeds to a licensed Samoan bank within 6 months from the date of shipment and must convert into WST unless a specific exemption is granted. A Samoa International Company is explicitly carved out from the resident definition in the International Companies Act and is therefore exempt from the surrender obligation and conversion mandate. All proceeds from the export of handmade RPG dice may be retained in designated foreign-currency accounts. The exemption must be evidenced by the IC registration certificate, a central bank acknowledgement (export code), and commercial invoices listing the consignee and shipment details. The CBS may require an annual update on the volume and currency mix of export receipts for statistical maintenance but no mandatory conversion ratio applies.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: High for the collection of payments from Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal in USD and EUR, and for onward disbursement to suppliers using offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Payoneer, Wise, and Currenxie. Legal constraints: EMIs are not recognised as deposit-taking institutions under the Central Bank of Samoa Act and cannot hold WST balances, issue local payment cards, or execute Samoan domestic transfers. Offshore EMI accounts may be used as virtual treasury vehicles for e-commerce settlements and supplier payments, but the Samoa IC must maintain a licensed local settlement account (or a corresponding bank account in a permissible jurisdiction) for any capital flows that touch the Samoan banking system. The CBS imposes no direct ban on EMI use for non-resident ICs; however, the IC should ensure that the EMI's KYC and AML regime is deemed equivalent to the SAMOA AML/CFT framework, and that no Samoan-resident beneficiary receives funds through the EMI without a local banking intermediary.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not mandated for a Samoa International Company when all beneficial owners and directors are non-residents. The CBS has adopted remote onboarding practices that permit Verifiable Credentials and video identification, subject to the bank's risk appetite. In general practice, at least one director or an authorised signatory holding a notarised power of attorney must complete a live video interview with the bank's compliance officer. If the company has appointed a licensed Samoa registered agent, the agent can act as the in-person representative for original document verification and submit the KYC pack on behalf of the entity. A hybrid model is permitted: the corporate registry search is performed online, the certificate of incumbency is provided by the registered agent, and the final sign-off is done via a recorded video call. For ultra-high-risk jurisdictions (not applicable to Samoa) physical attendance at the Samoan High Commission or Consulate would be required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore company with 100% non-resident ownership and no local economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; certificate of incumbency listing directors and shareholders; registered agent's licence; a board resolution summarising the real business activities (handmade resin dice manufacturing, sales via Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal) and a supply-chain overview; source-of-funds declaration for initial deposits; 12-month business plan with projected sales, procurement, and logistics; proof of non-resident tax status; if the IC has no employees, a statement confirming the reason and detailing how the registered agent and external paralegal provide substance functions in Samoa.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Heterogeneous crowdfunding inflows from Kickstarter with hundreds of unrelated global backers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payout statements from Kickstarter and Stripe showing the transaction volume; the campaign's public URL and terms; email confirmation of the campaign from Kickstarter's compliance team; a pivot table of backer countries alongside the shipping addresses (anonymised where necessary); sales invoices/receipts issued to each backer group; courier tracking logs for the dice deliveries; reconciliation of the aggregate inflows against the outbound shipping costs and raw material purchases; a letter from the project creator explaining the production timeline and any refund processing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No prior banking relationship in Samoa and the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) is not a Samoa resident
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO identification: passport, national ID, proof of residential address, and professional background; non-resident personal tax registration (if any) from the jurisdiction of tax residence; a sanctions/PEPS self-declaration; independent legal opinion on the legitimacy of source of wealth; corporate register extract showing the shareholding chain; two references from banks or regulated financial institutions; certified translation of any non-English corporate documents; and a declaration of no adverse media against the UBO.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial capital injection for a Samoa International Company (standing capital may be zero if no distribution has been made) must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder/beneficial owner. Field 70 (Remittance Information) should contain the purpose code 'INVC' (Investment Capital) along with the company name and share subscription reference. The bank may request a certified copy of the board resolution authorising the issuance of shares and the register of members. To avoid triggering anti-money-laundering reviews, the transfer amount must be consistent with the issued share capital stated at onboarding; any material difference must be supported by a written share subscription agreement and a certificate of incumbency. For payments above USD 100,000 or the WST equivalent, a pre-onboarding declaration to the CBS under the automatic exemption for non-resident ICs is advised, and the bank will issue a receipt confirming the foreign-currency status of the funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and logistics payments will be cleared primarily using SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers with ISO 20022 purpose code 'TRAD' (Trade) or 'GDS' (General Trade) in field 77B. For shipments of epoxy resin, silicone moulds, polyhedral dice parts, pigments, and freight forwarding services, the following rails are available: (1) Standard wire transfer for amounts up to USD 50,000 with a scanned invoice as an attachment to the bank's digital portal; (2) For orders above USD 50,000, an irrevocable standby commercial L/C issued by a licensed bank is acceptable, but in practice the bank will require a pro-forma invoice, shipping schedule, and customs valuation report; (3) For high-frequency small-value disbursements (e.g., PayPal payouts to supply chain artisans), an approved prepaid card or an EMI virtual account can be used, with periodic reconciliation to the operational account. The CBS retains the authority to request supporting trade documents for any transaction exceeding USD 100,000 per month, but for an IC the timeline for verification is generally one to two business days.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/WST vanilla forward contracts (1–12 months tenor) executed with ANZ Bank Samoa Limited or BSP Samoa with no CBS pre-clearance for trade-hedging purposes
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/WST referencing the CBS fix, permitted for an IC when the underlying exposure does not involve repeated local conversions
Cross-currency swaps between USD and EUR for procurement expenses, subject to prior CBS notification because the tenor exceeds 12 months
Currency options on major crosses (EUR/USD) available only through a registered offshore broker with a local settlement agent

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal Application and Annual Return (International Companies Act 1987, as amended; International Companies (Fees) Regulations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation; if the anniversary falls on a weekend or public holiday, the next business day
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee accrues at 10% per month or part thereof, up to a maximum of 100% of the annual fee; continued non-payment for three months permits the Registrar to publish a striking-off notice in the Samoa Official Gazette and dissolve the company after a 90-day objection period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Declaration by Registered Agent confirming particulars, registered office, shareholder details, and no disqualifying changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the annual renewal application; no separate statutory deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the declaration renders the renewal incomplete; the Registrar may reject the renewal, apply late penalties, and after three months of non-compliance commence administrative strike-off and dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: International Companies are exempt from the audit, filing, and public disclosure requirements of Samoa's Companies Act 2001. A mandatory audit arises only if the International Company becomes licensed by the Samoa Central Bank under financial services legislation or if a voluntary audited statement is required by a financing party. No monetary thresholds apply to a standard International Company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB, or an internationally accepted accounting framework such as U.S. GAAP, may be used for internal records. Statutory records must reflect the company's financial position with reasonable accuracy, but financial statements are not filed with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On each share transfer, the board must approve the transfer, update the Register of Members within 14 days, and the registered agent must refresh customer due diligence and beneficial ownership declarations for each new member. Annually, before the renewal date, the registered agent must obtain a written confirmation of current beneficial owners and controlling persons from the directors. This confirmation is not filed with the Registrar and remains in the agent's AML/CFT file. Changes to directors or shareholders must be notified to the Registrar within 14 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for a standard International Company; voluntary IFRS audit preparation for bank or counterparty purposes ranges from USD 2,500 to 5,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (general resident-company CIT rate); 0% effective statutory rate for International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act 1987, s.144 exemption.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory zero-rate ring-fence for ICs: exemption from income tax on worldwide business profits, capital gains tax, stamp duty and withholding taxes; no VAT/GST analogue applies. Recurrent cost is limited to the annual government fee on the IC and fixed ESR compliance costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return — Form 11 filed with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); electronic lodgement through the Samoa Companies Online Registry (SCORE).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation, together with payment of the annual government fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name, registration number, incorporation date, registered office and registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the licensed Samoan registered agent's address; foreign business addresses are not accepted as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B — Share capital and shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued capital, classes of shares and full shareholder list with nationality and beneficial ownership details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach identity documentation for each non-resident shareholder; nominee holdings must be disclosed to the agent but may remain off the public registry if permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses and passport numbers of all directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may be appointed but must execute consent forms; a Samoan-resident secretary or agent is required as correspondence contact.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certificate by the licensed registered agent that company registers, financial records and ESR evidence are retained or readily accessible.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent accepts continuing liability for record-keeping; records may be kept offshore under ICA s.74 only after written notice to the Registrar.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement triggers a 10% surcharge on the annual government fee per commenced quarter; persistent non-filing can result in automatic deregistration after three months, a restoration fee equal to two years' annual fees, and personal penalty units (each unit WST 100) imposed on directors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Companies (Economic Substance) Annual Return — prescribed form under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019; filed online with the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) through the MySRA e-Services portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of each accounting year; the IC must notify SRA of its accounting year-end no later than seven months after incorporation or within 30 days of changing it.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part 1 — Entity identification and income position
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC name, registration number, TIN, accounting period, gross income and net income attributable to the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs must report worldwide gross income from the polyhedral-dice casting and distribution business even where the exemption is claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tick-box designation of the activity: manufacturing/distribution, IP holding, pure equity holding or other.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: ISIC 3240 production and tabletop-gaming distribution is classified as a distribution and service centre; the IC must state the primary income-earning activity performed from Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of Samoan-resident employees, physical premises address, annual Samoan operating expenditure and place of board decision-making.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A minimum of one local employee/director and one Samoan office is expected for distribution activity; outsourced casting in a third country must be disclosed; direction and control must remain in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration signed by a director or registered agent confirming accuracy and authorising SRA to exchange information under international agreements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Samoan-resident director or agent must co-sign; non-resident shareholders should not act as sole signatory on the substance return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file attracts a penalty of up to 100 penalty units (WST 10,000) plus a daily default penalty of up to 10 penalty units per day; SRA may disregard the IC exemption, assess 27% tax on deemed Samoan income, deregister the IC, and exchange the file with the residence jurisdiction under the Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IR1 — Company Income Tax Return (Samoa Revenue Authority); mandatory only where an IC has lost or waived the s.144 exemption (e.g., trading with Samoa-resident customers or owning Samoan land); lodged via the SRA Taxpayer Online Filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six months after the end of the fiscal year, with full self-assessment payment of any CIT and a P&L schedule annexed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, tax file/TIN, fiscal year end, residential status indicator.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC that elected domestic taxation files as a resident company; otherwise tick non-resident and attach the s.144 exemption certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenue from dice casting, Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal settlement proceeds, royalties and foreign-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt ICs write 'Exempt under ICA 1987 s.144' and leave the assessment boxes at zero; foreign-source income of a non-resident IC is not assessable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dividends, interest and royalties paid to non-residents during the year, with WHT liability reported.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: ICs are not required to complete this box; if exemption has been lost, self-assess 15% WHT on distributions to non-resident shareholders.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5 penalty units plus 1 penalty unit per day up to 50 penalty units; underestimation penalties of up to 100% of the shortfall; interest accrues at 8% per annum on unpaid tax, and the Commissioner may issue a departure objection certificate preventing directors and officers from leaving Samoa until amounts are secured.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Samoan International Company to non-resident shareholders (statutory IC exemption); the general statutory rate for resident companies is 15% on dividends paid to non-residents.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Execution is typically unnecessary because IC dividends carry a 0% domestic rate. If the entity ever becomes resident/domestic, claim relief by: (i) obtaining a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the shareholder's tax authority; (ii) filing SRA's WHT relief application before payment or within 12 months after payment; (iii) producing a certificate of beneficial ownership and shareholding period. Samoa's only in-force comprehensive DTAs (Australia and New Zealand) reduce dividend WHT generally to 15% (5%-10% for substantial shareholdings); no DTA exists with China or Hong Kong, so PRC/HK investors rely exclusively on the IC 0% exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory: 15% WHT on royalties and 15% on interest paid by a Samoa resident company to non-residents. DTA rates with Australia/New Zealand generally reduce interest and royalties to 10%. IC regime: 0% WHT applies to royalty and interest payments made by an IC to non-resident recipients, preserving the tax-free profit repatriation structure for the polyhedral-dice brand and financing.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Samoa prescribes no statutory Local File/Master File monetary threshold for exempt ICs; best-practice contemporaneous documentation (Local File, Master File, CBCR exemption analysis) is mandatory where intercompany payments exceed WST 1,000,000 (approximately USD 370,000) per annum or where the IC derives more than 50% of gross income from related-party sales of dice through a Hong Kong or New Zealand distribution hub.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 apply to all ICs carrying on relevant activities. Tabletop RPG dice production and distribution falls within the 'distribution and service centre' category (and the IP brand holding is scrutinised under the IP-business substance test). The IC must maintain a Samoan office, resident employees proportionate to income, local board control, and minimum annual Samoan expenditure, and must file the annual ESR return; failure to meet the test is fatal because SRA will deem the profits taxable at 27% and exchange information with the shareholder's residence country.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion / filing a false economic substance return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying in the ESR return that dice casting, management and board meetings occur in Samoa while manufacturing is fully outsourced to a third-country resin caster, sales decisions are taken in Hong Kong, and the Samoan office is only a mail-forwarding address.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to WST 50,000 (100 penalty units) and daily default penalties of WST 1,000 per day; reassessment of 27% CIT on the entire undeclared revenue with a 100% evasion uplift and 8% per annum interest; referral to the Samoa Attorney General for criminal proceedings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent who signed the false return are jointly and severally liable for the company's tax debts; the Commissioner may issue travel restraints (departure objection certificates) against each director; conviction carries imprisonment of up to three years and disqualification from acting as a director in Samoa for ten years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure tax-shield: no Samoan bank account, no resident employees, no premises, and 100% of online sales (Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal) directed to the offshore founder while the IC books the margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SRA may set aside the s.144 exemption, assess 27% CIT on gross receipts with penalty surcharges, order deregistration of the IC, and automatically transmit the file to the beneficial owner's residence jurisdiction under the Global Forum and CRS exchange framework; registration of the IC as a 'non-compliant' entity can trigger additional annual penalties of WST 10,000 per year.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: directors face civil restitution of diverted profits, personal fines of up to WST 100,000, obtaining a departure ban preventing them from leaving Samoa by air or sea pending payment, and imprisonment of up to five years for fraudulent evasion where the PayPal and Stripe balances were concealed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using nominee shareholders, incomplete BO registers, or failing to disclose the ultimate founder operating the Kickstarter-Stripe-PayPal payment rails while an undisclosed related trust in Hong Kong controls the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalties under Samoa's AML/CFT Act of up to WST 100,000 for the IC and WST 50,000 per responsible officer; the Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze funds held in remittance accounts and impose record-keeping penalties of 5 penalty units per day until the BO register is corrected.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and agents who knowingly permitted anonymous control are personally liable for AML fines, subject to criminal prosecution carrying imprisonment of up to five years, forfeiture of the sales proceeds, and cancellation of the registered agent's licence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring a Hong Kong buying vehicle that purchases polyhedral dice from the Samoan IC at a 90% discount and resells to global retailers, leaving no functional or risk profile in Samoa and no arm's length benchmarking file.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SRA may make a transfer pricing adjustment to restore arm's length profit in Samoa, impose 27% CIT on the adjusted profit, and add penalties equal to 50%-100% of the underpaid tax plus interest; in the alternative, the IC exemption is revoked for failure to demonstrate substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors authorising the related-party contracts are personally liable for the tax shortfall as shadow directors; courts may issue worldwide freezing orders, travel bans, and restitution orders against the founder; aggravated fraud convictions carry imprisonment of up to ten years.
